papers.title: Mental World Modeling
papers.desc: World models enable a predictive substrate for planning and action, yet existing formulations merely answer a physical question: what/where it is, and how will it evolve.

papers.title: N_0-TWAM: Scaling Tactile-Native World-Action Model for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.desc: We present N_0-TWAM, a tactile-native world-action model for contact-rich manipulation that predicts both future vision and future contact.

papers.title: SAF-OPD: Stable Advantage Fusion for On-Policy Distillation
papers.desc: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) broadcasts a single response-level reward to every token, while on-policy distillation (OPD) scores each token against a stronger teacher for a dense advantage but caps performance at teacher quality and discourages exploration beyond it.

papers.title: Fewer Clarifications, Better Code: Benchmarking Cross-Session Personalized Ambiguity Adaptation in Coding Assistants
papers.desc: AI-assisted coding increasingly translates informal user intent into executable software, yet coding requests often contain ambiguities that recur in user-specific ways across tasks and sessions.

papers.title: ODEWorld: A Continuous Predictive Architecture via Physical-Time Flow
papers.desc: In the physical world we inhabit, space and time are fundamentally continuous.

papers.title: RL^2-VLA: Adaptive RL Latent Compositional Steering with Test-Time Scaling for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.desc: Despite the impressive visuomotor capabilities enabled by Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, their performance often degrades on challenging and out-of-domain tasks.

papers.title: EMBL AI Librarian: Life-Sciences Knowledge Layer for AI Agents
papers.desc: The web is increasingly accessed by AI agents rather than humans.

papers.title: One Future, Every Robot: Label-Efficient Collective-State Prediction with Decentralized JEPA
papers.desc: Can every robot in a swarm predict the same future collective state from only local observations and bandwidth-limited messages? We formulate this as decentralized shared-state prediction and introduce Collective-State JEPA (CS-JEPA), a recurrent joint-embedding predictive architecture whose output at every robot represents one common future token field.

papers.title: Not All Tokens Deserve Equal Credit: Counterfactual Sensitivity Credit Reallocation for Long-CoT Reasoning
papers.desc: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is central to improving long-CoT reasoning in large language models.

papers.title: Toward Robust and 3D-Aware RGB-NIR Imaging in the Dark
papers.desc: Robust low-light imaging remains challenging for the community.

papers.title: Beyond Feeling Better: Capability-Sustaining Emotional Dialogue as a Longitudinal Research Paradigm
papers.desc: Emotional dialogue research includes two influential strategy traditions.

papers.title: In the Driver's Seat: A Multi-Company Study on the Reality of Autonomous Driving System Testing
papers.desc: Autonomous driving systems (ADS) are rapidly advancing and increasingly deployed in real-world applications.

papers.title: SULAND v2: A Refined RGB Dataset and Deep Learning Object Detection Benchmark for UAV/UGV-Based SUrface LANDmine Detection Under Domain Shift
papers.desc: RGB imagery offers a practical, low-cost option for Unmanned Aerial/Ground Vehicle (UAV/UGV) survey support in surface-landmine detection, but object detectors remain underexplored in this safety-critical domain.

papers.title: SGTP: Sampling-based Game-Theoretic Planning for Real-Time Multi-Vehicle Autonomous Racing
papers.desc: Autonomous multi-vehicle racing requires real-time planning of diverse competitive behaviors in intense interactions.

papers.title: Would You Walk to the Car Wash? Revealing the Salience Bias of Large Language Models in Commonsense Reasoning
papers.desc: As large language models (LLMs) continue to advance in complex reasoning tasks, they have learned to heavily prioritize explicit conditions provided in the input.
